scripts.electron:dev: npx cross-env VITE_API_URL=https://aynkaran-backend.onrender.com VITE_PORT=4173 concurrently "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 --strictPort false" "npx wait-on http://localhost:4173 && npx cross-env VITE_API_URL=https://aynkaran-backend.onrender.com VITE_PORT=4173 npx electron ."
